subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the refreshed group of action upgrades be accepted together after required CI passes, or should the secret-bearing and release-critical action updates be reviewed separately?
rationale: These immutable dependency upgrades are mechanically clean but replace code that executes with credentials and release/security permissions, so acceptance of the grouped supply-chain risk requires maintainer judgment.

options.title: Refresh and merge together
options.body: Regenerate the Dependabot branch on current main, spot-check upstream release notes for sensitive actions, and merge the group after required checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate GitHub App token, registry login/build, Codex, and CodeQL upgrades into smaller PRs for isolated rollout and rollback.

options.title: Defer the group
options.body: Close or pause this update and wait for a later Dependabot group if the review cost outweighs the immediate dependency benefit.

recommendation.title: Refresh and merge together
recommendation.body: Regenerate the Dependabot branch on current main, spot-check upstream release notes for sensitive actions, and merge the group after required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The available workflow history most directly connects this account to CI and release workflow decisions spanning the changed surfaces.
